rounds.purpose: Rebuild the identity reference before production generation.

passed: Single cut, not a contact sheet.
Background measured at 139,139,138 and uniform across every sampled patch.
Mouth safe zone clear: mouth closed, no hair, no hand, no hard shadow.
Detail outside the safe zones matches the design sheet.
failed: Eye safe zone: a bang crosses the viewer-left eyebrow and reaches the upper lid. The brow is fully occluded. The viewer-right brow is correct.

matte_test.method: Alpha from distance to the flat background colour, threshold 34, unpremultiplied to de-spill, composited over a warm cream plate.
matte_test.notes: Flyaway strands survive matting without a grey halo. The earlier concern about fine strands is resolved by the flat background. Hair needs no change. This validates the cut-out plus scene-plate composition model on real output.

open_questions: Neckline is more open than the buttoned blouse in the wardrobe reference. Decide whether to align the wardrobe.
Rendering reads slightly more photoreal and glossier than the 2.5D design sheet.
assets.next: Localised fix of the left bang only. Full regeneration is a fallback, not the preference.
